Second, the boots also enable him to travel at normal speed across the most slippery ice (horizontal surfaces only, not vertical or sharply slanted ones) without falling or slipping. data.name: Boots of the Winterlands

raw_tokens.value: Equipment|AUTOMATIC|Boots of the Winterlands ~ Snow Travel|Boots of the Winterlands ~ Slippery Ice|Boots of the Winterlands ~ Save Bonus
Construction Requirements|Craft Wondrous Item, cat's grace, endure elements, pass without trace

This footgear bestows many powers upon the wearer. First, he is able to travel across snow at his normal speed, leaving no tracks. Second, the boots also enable him to travel at normal speed across the most slippery ice (horizontal surfaces only, not vertical or sharply slanted ones) without falling or slipping. Finally, boots of the winterlands warm the wearer, as if he were affected by an endure elements spell.
